hoverRules: #dabar a.dabar__button:hover, #dabar a.dabar__button:focus { background: var(--dabar-button-bg, #fff); color: var(--dabar-button-color, #111); opacity: 0.85; }
#dabar .dabar__message a:hover, #dabar .dabar__message a:focus { color: var(--dabar-link-color, inherit); opacity: 0.8; }
#dabar .dabar__close:hover { background: transparent; color: var(--dabar-close-color, currentColor); opacity: 0.7; }
.brxe-dropdown:not([data-toggle="click"]):hover .brx-dropdown-content::after { bottom: 100%; content: ""; height: var(--brx-dropdown-height-before,0); position: absolute; width: 100%; z-index: 1; }
